notes.title: Weapon Handling Update
notes.content:
Weapon handling has been massively improved !

Smaller Fixes:

- Shotguns spread is now tighter which should improve accuracy, increased bullet amount per shot.

 - Gorilla attack pattern has been greatly improved

 - Male lion will now deal proper damage

- Fixed targetting for some predators

- Removed some trees where jeep would clip

- M4 recoil has been reduced slightly

notes.title: Release Hot Fixes (5/15/2022):
notes.content:
- Fixed issue where red dot optic was not appearing in Rifle Scope.

 - Changed Bolt Action Rifle to be semi auto with only 5 shots. Simply reload a new magazine and you're good to shoot. This change is being done because of how hard it can be to reach the bolt without colliding the controllers due to Oculus controller ergonomics. This has lead to multiple users having trouble loading a new round into the chamber and this takes away from players doing what they need to do. Shoot!

 - Increased load radius at bottom of shotgun to create a more fluid reloading cycle.

 - Some weapons have had their price reduced.

I will continue to update it as much as possible to make sure players are given the experience I designed the game for. Thank you to everyone who has played the game, your feedback is invaluable! 

- Mikey D
